items.text:
i try this game and it did not work at all the fps kept dropping
cause it was running on one ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ CPU core.
the game it self is not fun nothing is conveyed to the player at all.
they want you to go to their discord to get any information about the game

the game uses a task system that is not shown to the player so your character will randomly just start wandering off to do things ( it's on the sidebar but it's dumb how it's not shown on the screen when you're doing things)

game is super pixelized more than the images on the store page
to the point where you can't make out a single damn thing on the screen
I don't know if that's the developer's intent but that's pretty dumb if that's the intent

so if you like eye strain this is a game for you
also I did not realize the game has food and needs bar. You cannot disable
honestly I don't feel like dealing with the sim in a game that's trying to be complex

sorry for any misspellings or grammar errors.
items.text_zh:
我试了这款游戏，结果完全没法玩，帧率一直往下掉
因为它只在一个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥CPU核心上运行。
游戏本身一点都不好玩，什么信息都不传达给玩家。
他们想让你去他们的discord获取任何关于游戏的信息

游戏使用了一个不向玩家展示的任务系统，所以你的角色会莫名其妙地开始自己跑去干事情（它在侧边栏上有显示，但你在做事的时候它不显示在屏幕上，这太蠢了）

游戏像素化程度比商店页面上的图片还严重
严重到你在屏幕上连一个该死的东西都分辨不出来
我不知道这是不是开发者的本意，但如果是本意的话那就太蠢了

所以如果你喜欢眼睛疲劳，这款游戏适合你
另外我没意识到游戏有食物和需求条。你没法禁用
说实话，我不想在一个试图变得复杂的游戏里应付模拟经营那一套

如有拼写或语法错误，抱歉。
